items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: See we've got some photographs here. From Alma Williams.

ctx.x: Yeah. But you know I've recorded the rebirth. The new birth. The young Olympians. The soul rebels. And. The little rascals. All of those. All those young brass band players. You know. We had a chance to. I had a chance to do that.
See we've got some photographs here. From Alma Williams. And she wants you to identify. I guess some people in the photo. Looks like they don't. Have anyone. This is from July 5th.
